Thank you, Gulya.
Rest for now, sit for a bit.
You can watch television in the room.
Alright, thank you very much.
Of course, be glad, but still be careful.
My friend also had a housekeeper just like this.
Such a quiet and modest girl.
And one day suddenly all the money disappeared.
I am not like that at all.
Vera, will you lend me five thousand until my pension?
Yes, I will bring it right now.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'I', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Сейчас приготовим, нам две звезды даст!
examples.trans: We will cook it right now, he will give us two stars!

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will bring', paired with 'приносить'.

examples.text: Костя, принеси еще бутылку вина для инспектора!
examples.trans: Kostya, bring another bottle of wine for the inspector!

examples.text: Да, сейчас принесу.
examples.trans: Yes, I will bring it right now.

examples.text: Что ты в квартиру принёс?
examples.trans: What did you bring into the flat?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'where', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А где наш Лёва?
examples.trans: And where is our Lyova?

examples.text: Где у вас туалет?
examples.trans: Where is your restroom?

examples.text: А где мои деньги?
examples.trans: And where is my money?
